style.source: libtmux/libtmux-cxx .clang-format at 3f93b021cb51e8349bfb9cecc6fd4091f6e79a0f, the revision cxx.json is extracted from

context: Each raw declaration is a member of "struct ApiDeclarations { ... };" formatted with --assume-filename=include/libtmux.hpp, the same wrapper scripts/gen-api-model.mjs uses, and the struct indent is removed. The two columns of struct indent are why the project limit of 88 printed 86 columns, and why a printed budget of N columns uses ColumnLimit N + 2.

groups.corpus: declarations from site/src/data/api/cxx.json, one per distinct layout shape
groups.synthetic: hand-written declarations with trailing returns, variadics, defaults, requires clauses and noexcept expressions that cxx.json does not contain
groups.narrow: both groups at an unusually narrow budget
